description: Open or close up to 100 conversations in one call, e.g. to close every conversation returned by list_conversations. Returns updatedIds, unchangedIds (already had the status) and notFoundIds (missing or in another company); only changed conversations are rewritten, so retrying is safe.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

conversationIds.description: Conversation IDs to update, from 1 to 100. Duplicates are ignored.

status.description: New status for every listed conversation.

name: bulk_update_conversation_status

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `bulk_update_conversation_status` MCP tool.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

notFound.description: IDs that do not exist in the selected company.

notFoundIds.description: IDs that do not exist in the selected company.

unchanged.description: Conversations that already had the status.

unchangedIds.description: IDs that already had the status.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
